title: Christmas At the Farmstead
seo_title: Christmas at the Farmstead in Springfield, MO
description: Christmas at the Farmstead is an old-fashioned holiday event with hot cocoa, cookies, tree trimming, music, and a visit with Santa. You can also shop at Santa's Workshop for craft kits that work as stocking stuffers. It takes place Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 1 to 3 PM and again from 5 to 8 PM at 2400 S Scenic Ave in Springfield, Missouri.
